events.title: 토트넘 홋스퍼 sell winger Vinny Samways to 에버턴 for £2.2 million.
토트넘 홋스퍼 pay a club record £2.6 million for Romania winger Ilie Dumitrescu .
애스턴 빌라 pay 윔블던 £1.35 million for long-serving striker John Fashanu , and 토트넘 홋스퍼 pay AS 모나코 £2 million for German striker Jürgen Klinsmann .
A second Romanian World Cup star, defender Dan Petrescu , joins a Premier League club. Petrescu, 27, signs for 셰필드 웬즈데이 in a £1.3 million deal.
뉴캐슬 유나이티드 pay a club record £2.65 million for Belgium and 안더레흐트 defender Philippe Albert .
After more than 13 years at 리버풀 , goalkeeper Bruce Grobbelaar signs for 사우샘프턴 on a free transfer.
첼시 sign midfielder David Rocastle from 맨체스터 시티 for £1.25 million. A tribunal orders 셰필드 웬즈데이 to pay £1 million for 포트 베일 midfielder Ian Taylor.

The Football League season kicks off. 올덤 애슬레틱 , relegated from the Premier League last season, start with a 5–2 home win over 찰턴 애슬레틱 . 대니 윌슨 begins his managerial career by guiding 반즐리 to a 2–1 home win over last season's beaten playoff finalists 더비 카운티 . 셰필드 유나이티드 begin their quest for an immediate return to the Premier League by beating 왓퍼드 3–0 at Bramall Lane . 그림즈비 타운 and 볼턴 원더러스 draw 3–3 at Blundell Park .
Eric Cantona converts a penalty and Paul Ince is also on the scoresheet as 맨체스터 유나이티드 beat 블랙번 로버스 2–0 in the 1994 FA Charity Shield .
레스터 시티 play their first top flight game since their relegation from the old First Division in May 1987, but lose 3–1 at home to 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 .
아약스 claims the Dutch Super Cup , the annual opening of the new season in the Eredivisie , by a 3–0 win over 페예노르트 in the Olympisch Stadion .
Bryan Roy's fine start in English football continues when he scores the equaliser for 노팅엄 포리스트 as they hold double winners 맨체스터 유나이티드 to a 1–1 draw at the City Ground .
레스터 시티 suffer another defeat in the Premier League, this time losing 3–0 to 블랙번 로버스 at Ewood Park .
뉴캐슬 유나이티드 top the Premier League after two games by beating 코번트리 시티 4–0 on Tyneside . 맨체스터 시티 beat 웨스트햄 유나이티드 3–0 at Maine Road .

National record signing Chris Sutton scores a hat-trick for 블랙번 로버스 as they beat 코번트리 시티 4–0, with all of 블랙번 로버스's goals coming during the final 15 minutes after Coventry were reduce to 10 men after Micky Quinn was sent off. Andy Cole and Steve Watson are both on the scoresheet twice for 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 in their 5–1 home win over 사우샘프턴, as are Uwe Rosler and Paul Walsh for 맨체스터 시티 in a 4–0 home win over 에버턴. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 are still top of the Premier League. The race to win promotion to the Premier League is currently led by 미들즈브러 , who have won their first three league games under the management of Bryan Robson .
19-year-old striker Robbie Fowler scores a hat-trick for 리버풀 in less than five minutes as they beat 아스널 3–0 in the league at Anfield .
Newly promoted 노팅엄 포리스트 go top of the Premier League with a 2–1 win at 에버턴.

뉴캐슬 유나이티드 finish the first month of the league season as Premier League leaders with four wins from their opening four games, with defending champions 맨체스터 유나이티드 and newly promoted 노팅엄 포리스트 bracketed together as their nearest rivals and 리버풀 and 첼시 three points behind with a game in hand each. With four teams going down this season due to the reduction of the Premier League from 22 clubs to 20, the relegation places are occupied by 에버턴, 레스터 시티, 웨스트햄 유나이티드 and 코번트리 시티. In Division One, Bryan Robson has made a perfect start to his managerial career by guiding 미들즈브러 to the top of Division One after winning their first four games of the season. 올덤 애슬레틱 occupy second place – but for the first time in 100 years of the Football League 's second tier the runners-up of the division will not gain automatic promotion. Due to a reorganisation of the Premier League and Football League for next season, the second to fifth placed teams in Division One will go into the playoffs, which are also currently occupied by 포츠머스 , 밀월 and Reading . The number of relegation places from Division One are unchanged – they are occupied by 더비 카운티 , 사우스엔드 유나이티드 , and 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 .
